# laravelforge_firewall_rules (Resource)

Add a new firewall rule to the server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "laravelforge_firewall_rules" "example" {
  organization = "my-org"
  server       = 123456
  type         = "allow"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) The organization slug
- `server` (Number) The server ID
- `type` (String)

### Optional

- `ip_address` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ip_address))
- `name` (String) The name of the firewall rule.
- `port` (String) The port or port range for the firewall rule.
- `rule` (Number) The rule ID

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The date and time the firewall rule was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String) The status of the firewall rule.
- `updated_at` (String) The date and time the firewall rule was last updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import laravelforge_firewall_rules.example my-org/123456/123
```
